title: Mount Wilson cover-up: buried fried servers and rail system

tellings.quote: about the same time, and we uncovered evidence that there there was activity uh predate there was a cover-up. I mean, we're talking about fried

plain: At a Mount Wilson property linked to Robert Bigelow, a businessman who owned it, there was a cover-up around 1996: buried computer servers that had been "fried" and a hidden rail system, along with signs of activity older than the official story. That account comes from the owner of Skinwalker Ranch, a property known for strange reports, who says he uncovered this evidence himself and told it in an episode billed as him breaking his silence. If true, it would mean someone worked to hide what had gone on at the site.
